emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI Infrastructure challenger (score 1.745, durability 0.66, non-crowded) can close the 0.595 margin against Memory/HBM leadership — a confirmed handoff would be the challenger's rank score overtaking the leader's while both remain eligible; retire the watch if the margin widens above 0.8 for 10 consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only top-5 theme with both a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and the highest durability_bar (0.76) and breadth (0.9) in the leaderboard, suggesting cohesion and staying power rather than an attention spike. It is crowded (crowding_z 1.82), which is a size-down caution only, not a fade. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg and this theme passes it with the strongest trend-health reading.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is flagged crowded, and the guardrails warn that crowding marks attention tops; a crowded theme with high durability can still unwind rapidly if the AI-infrastructure narrative absorbs all thematic flow (absorption already 0.32).

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The theme leads the ranks (score 2.34, rank 1) with the second-highest breadth (0.75) and a broad rotation (0.51 eligible), and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.53). The absolute-trend gate is active and this theme is eligible, so the validated drawdown-control leg favors staying power. This is a trend-following lean on the prevailing narrative, not a momentum-return bet (rank-IC ~0).
evidence: rotation.leader is memory_storage with margin 0.595 over challenger
theses.dissent: The Hurst tag is 'mixed' not 'trend', and val_state is 'diverging'; the theme leads on momentum (a ~0 rank-IC focus lens) but has weaker trend-health than Cybersecurity or AI Semiconductors, so it could be an attention top rather than durable leadership.

falsifier.text: SMH falls more than 4% from its 20-day high while CIBR holds within 2% of its own

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: AI Semiconductors has the best durability_bar (0.85) and breadth (0.917) in the entire leaderboard with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.69). It ranks below Memory and AI Infrastructure on momentum, but its trend-health is the strongest, which is the leg that matters for the validated gate.
theses.dissent: SMH is shared as the proxy for Memory, AI Infrastructure, and Semiconductor Equipment, so the theme is not cleanly separable and a single SMH position cannot distinguish it; momentum rank is weak and the theme could simply be a correlated expression of the Memory leadership.
